scope: Hero ordinary Awakening + Hero Twice/Blood Awakening mission lifecycle. Pet awakening excluded.

core_correction.reality: The active UI/task flow does not use AWAKE_HERO for finalization. TASK_AWAKE_OPEN starts mission state, qualifying battle result reports mission completion, and TAKE_MISSION_AWARD finalizes. SelfPlayer.awakeHero appears stale/dead/version-drift.

ordinary_awaken.stage1: Exclusive-awaken gear/material requirement. Opening is initiated from the Hero gear slot/UI and persisted as TaskType.AWAKE mission state.
ordinary_awaken.auxiliary_stage_minus1: 137 source rows represent extra/parallel mode objectives. TaskAwakeCell only renders stages 1/2; treat -1 as auxiliary server-tracked task records until runtime contract is characterized.
ordinary_awaken.stage2: Hero-specific Campaign objective. SelectTeam preselects the awakening Hero and BattleCreate evaluates the special condition locally.
ordinary_awaken.battle_completion_signal: BattleCreate adds awake_mission=<mission_id> to FIGHT_RESULT only when getAwakeMissionResult() is true. Sweep requests can also carry awake_mission.
ordinary_awaken.final_claim: TaskAwakeCell calls TAKE_MISSION_AWARD. On final mission success, client locally changes Hero table_id beforeAwakenID->afterAwakenID and enables Awake skill. Future server must persist equivalent canonical Hero state atomically without generic double projection.

blood_awaken.stage1: Bloodline exclusive gear requirement; 75/81 source rows route to campaign 1300003, with special-case routes for six heroes.
blood_awaken.stage2: Dedicated AwakeTwiceSelectTeamWindow. Requires at least two selected heroes and starts UNLIMIT_START_FIGHT with twice_awake_mission and incubus_id equal to mission id.
blood_awaken.result_signal: On win BattleUnlimit sends UNLIMIT_FIGHT_RESULT with twice_awake_mission=<mission_id>. On loss it does not mark mission success.
blood_awaken.final_claim: TAKE_MISSION_AWARD; client enables AwakeTwice skill. twice_awake_stage progresses 0 UNSTART -> 1 -> 2 -> 3 COMPLETE and must become server-canonical Hero state.

give_up.client_side_effects: For HERO_TWICE client resets twice_awake_stage=0; delete_item entries are removed locally after successful give-up. Server must persist matching state/inventory atomically and avoid double projection.

runtime_evidence_pass72.finding: legacy stub returns superficial success without creating awake mission state; failure is expected and becomes next dedicated mission-domain migration target

future_architecture.owner: Dedicated AwakeningMissionService/mission aggregate coordinated with HeroEntityMutationService and Campaign/Battle result handling
future_architecture.not_a_simple_hero_mid: Awakening is a cross-domain mission lifecycle: Task state + Campaign/special battle proof + inventory/equipment + final Hero state.
future_architecture.campaign_dependency: Ordinary Awakening completion is coupled to Campaign FIGHT_RESULT. Campaign Energy settlement remains a separate Campaign migration but should be designed in the same campaign transaction seam.

negative_memory: Do not implement the stale undefined AWAKE_HERO path as a guessed numeric MID.
Do not mark Campaign awakening objectives complete from FIGHT start alone; client sends awake_mission only on qualifying FIGHT_RESULT.
Do not trust arbitrary awake_mission supplied by clients without validating active mission, expected campaign, required Hero/condition and result semantics.
Do not model Blood Awakening stage2 as ordinary Campaign; it uses UNLIMIT_START_FIGHT/UNLIMIT_FIGHT_RESULT.
Do not treat auxiliary stage=-1 records as ordinary visible stages without runtime characterization.
